newsitem.title: USA: Wider rate spread fuels Barnett earnings.
newsitem.headline: Wider rate spread fuels Barnett earnings.

text.p: Barnett Banks Inc said on Wednesday a wider net interest spread helped its third-quarter operating earnings rise 6.1 percent, to $142.3 million from $134.1 million a year ago.

Net income in the quarter was $127.0 million, including a $15.3 million after-tax charge ($24.5 million pretax) for a special assessment by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund.
The assessment charge was equal to $0.08 per share, reducing earnings to $0.65 per share.
On an operating basis, fully diluted earnings per share rose 12 percent, to $0.73 from $0.65.
The percentage increase in per-share earnings reflected six percent fewer shares outstanding as a result of a share buyback program.
Net interest income in the third quarter increased five percent to $469.0 million, as the net yield on earning assets rose to 5.22 percent from 4.90 a year earlier.
Barnett said the increase in the margin was largely the result of strategic decisions that favorably changed the mix of earning assets and lower funding costs.
Non-interest income rose seven percent to $194.9 million. Consumer finance income was up more than 30 percent.
Non-interest expense, excluding the SAIF assessment, was up just one percent.
The provision for loan losses was $44.9 million in the third quarter, up from $34.2 million a year earlier. Net charge-offs were $45.1 million, up from $34.0 million.
Non-performing assets of $251 million on September 30 were down 11 percent from a year earlier.

The reserve for loan losses of $507 million represented 1.66 percent of loans and covered 264 percent of non-performing loans. Those ratios compared to 1.65 percent and 242 percent, respectively, a year earlier.

Barnett said a previously announced alliance with Household International Inc to jointly build and manage Barnett's credit card business is expected to close in the fourth quarter. It said it anticipates the transaction will be accretive to earnings in 1997.
Third quarter operating earnings of $0.73 per share were $0.01 above the consensus estimate of analysts tracked by Institutional Brokers Estimate System.
